thread.title: Tech stock rally lifts indexes to session highs

title: Tech stock rally lifts indexes to session highs
text:
Published: May 4, 2018 10:20 a.m. ET Share Ryan Vlastelica Markets reporter
U.S. stocks rose on Friday, with technology stocks rallying and helping to lift major indexes to their highs of the session. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.39% rose 0.2% while the S&P 500 SPX, +1.28% was up 0.2% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.71% rose 0.5%. Technology stocks were among the best performers of the day, with the sector up 0.6%. Notably, Apple Inc. AAPL, +3.92% rose 2.8% after it was reported that Warren Buffett's company bought 75 million shares of the iPhone maker over the first quarter. Among other tech names, Facebook Inc. FB, +1.49% rose 0.9%. Quote References
